sections.title: Section 122 - Collection of Tax from Clearing and Forwarding Agents On the commission payable to the clearing and forwarding agent on import or export
sections.content_text: Section 122 - Collection of Tax from Clearing and Forwarding Agents On the commission payable to the clearing and forwarding agent on import or export of goods by any clearing and forwarding agent authorized under the Customs Act, 1969 (Act No. I of 1969), the Commissioner, Customs shall collect tax 10% (ten percent) on the commission of the agent.
